Internal heuristic distance (C++ implementation)

Source: R/RcppExports.R
dot-euk_heuristic_distance_impl.Rd

RcppParallel reimplementation of \codeeuk_heuristic_distance_r(). Each locus may have at most 64 distinct alleles.

Usage

.euk_heuristic_distance_impl(geno, ploidy, m, impute_data)

Arguments

geno

List of integer matrices.

ploidy

Integer vector of ploidy values.

m

Integer vector of m values.

impute_data

Integer (0/1). If 1, apply the two-pass Barratt missing-locus imputation.

Value

A symmetric distance matrix.
